name: ARCAS Short, airfoil cross-section with NO named section (desktop-import path)
_notes: PURPOSE (2026-08-29): the sharp-airfoil leading-edge cell. Byte-identical geometry to arcas-short.json except the fin set drops airfoilSection/airfoilLeDiamond/airfoilTeDiamond (all three are this project's extension tags, absent from every desktop-authored .ork), keeping crossSection: airfoil. That is exactly what a design imported from desktop OpenRocket looks like, and it takes the v0.075 sharp-airfoil branch (FinSetCalc.java:1074) that every other finned fixture short-circuits past via its named section (FinSetCalc.java:1034). Until this cell existed, the most-flown fin path had no anchor on it: v0.075 moved airfoil-fin CD 9-16% at Mach 2 and the harness scored 10/17/71 both before and after.

KEEP IN LOCKSTEP: any geometry change to arcas-short.json must be mirrored here (the finsoff siblings set the precedent). The two fixtures must differ ONLY by the three deleted keys, the name, and these notes.

WHAT THIS CELL MEASURES: the sharp-airfoil branch's accuracy against the same tunnel measurement the parent gates. Classic never reaches the flag-gated section code, so classic rows here duplicate the parent bit-for-bit (asserted in the 2026-08-29 scorecard); only Rogers Kbf and Supersonic can differ. The section fields feed pressure CD only - CP/CNa never read them - so the parent's CP series is deliberately NOT duplicated here (it would gate the identical numbers twice).
INHERITED CAVEAT: the fins-on M0.80-0.95 transonic anchors are under an open re-read suspicion of up to +0.11 (validation/README.md) - same posture as the parent cell.
